_comment: Quest threads (the player's Notes). Stage 0 = not started. Each stage: note, advance conditions, on_enter effects, optional branch. Notes are written as the player's own shorthand.

stages.note: The town well gives nothing. Someone in a brass helmet is fighting it.
Barnaby says the Lease at the west end is empty. Look around it.
Seeds, a tiller, an empty can. The well is still dry. Barnaby's been tracing the line.
Hold the plumb-glass up at the well [C]. Look at the ground the way the pipe sees it.
The well line has burst under the lane. Mend it with seal gum, then crank the well.
Water in the basin. Real water.
Till the plots by the Lease and plant the glowbeet seeds. Glowbeets like it warm, wet and lit.
Keep them watered. Lamps and glowroots help; sour air doesn't.
Glowbeets! Sell a few at the Exchange, or keep them for something better.
Your first harvest is on someone's table tonight.
Nothing refills the cistern since the Station pump died. Put a pump down in the Sink and pipe it to the cistern outlet.
The pump needs power. Odile sells burners. Hesper swears by the spring. Barnaby has a crank and opinions.
Water climbs to the cistern again. Whatever is making that power, people will notice it.
The Reach gate is open. Brass scrap, glowglass and blackstone lie below. Be home by Hush.
Someone built things down here once. Find a ruin and see what they left.
A Station 7 crew log, in a ruin a long way from Station 7.
Barnaby wants you to look at the Station pump. Just look. Use the glass in the pump hall.
The pump needs a governor coil and four seal gum. Barnaby says the only coil is in the Trunk chamber, past a passage that's been sealed for years.
The Tremor broke the seal. The Trunk chamber in the Reach is open. Find the governor coil.
Fit the governor coil and four seal gum to the Station pump, then give it fifty-five power.
Station 7 is breathing. Barnaby is standing very still in the pump hall.
Meet Barnaby at the Trunk valve, in the Sink beneath the pump hall. Through the glass.
Three. Two. Three.
A brass tag from a crew locker under the lane: W. ASKEW — TRUNK CREW. It's warm. Barnaby might know the name.
Wren Askew was down-line when Barnaby closed the Trunk valve. She knocked for an hour.
A note in Wren's hand, in the Trunk chamber. Eleven years old. 'Don't wait up.'
The Tremor split the ground under the Lease. Sour gas is climbing out of the old pocket. Pack the fissure with blackstone, scrub the air, or lose the plots.
The fissure is packed. The air over the farm is clearing.
On the fifth night Wick puts out every lamp to watch the grove bloom. Hesper and Odile disagree about the market lamps.
The grove bloomed so bright the lake held it twice. Hesper cried, efficiently.
The bloom came up thin. Nobody said why out loud. Everybody knew.
Odile wants to sell water and beets down-river for medicine before the damp season. She needs twenty glowbeets in the Exchange's stock.
The first trade crate went down-river. Odile wrote a number in the ledger and underlined it twice.
